catalog.name: FormFabric
catalog.summary: Garment pattern design and cloth simulation: draw patterns, sew, drape and export.

notes_for_owner: Data only, written from the registry contract (REGISTRY.md fields), no formcompiler script or workflow text. Flip enabled to true with the first compile_v branch after python3 scripts/registry.py check passes. The app repo satisfies the contract: ./formfabric install, install-desktop and desktop build [--config FILE] (bash) and the same three verbs in formfabric.bat, so windows_shell cmd should work; if the first Windows run fails in the bat path, set windows_shell to bash as formsculpt does. windows_msvc is true because the engine compiles C (ufbx) with the cc crate; set false if the runner's default environment is enough. rust_targets installs the wasm32 target the browser engine needs (rust-toolchain.toml lists it too). Add agents.mcp_launch {command, args} once the bundle path of the program is fixed: the installed program answers `mcp` as its first argument over stdio (macOS: Contents/MacOS/formfabric, Linux: the formfabric binary, Windows: formfabric.exe), so args is ["mcp"]. The updater pubkey stays empty in the app; formcompiler writes the key and endpoint at build time. Register the same id, kind, identifier and summary in formportal's catalog/products.json (formai_dev first) and add formfabric to the product enum of the package schemas if extension packs are wanted (see product-entry.json). Linux minimum_os is empty as for the other apps. The app repository owner is nodemode-dev; the updater endpoint inside the app's tauri.conf.json still names the formcompiler repository, which keeps its own owner.
